column1: # The X50 family recipe (every devices/<c>/build.conf with steps= this file: X50 Ultra, Ultra Max, TITAN Noir Pro and
# Max, ...): steps of tools/build/engine.py, WHEN<TAB>OP<TAB>ARGS. No model is named here: the descriptor gives the
# codename, MODEL, PREFIX, PCERT (its platform certificate) and stages the model's public certificates.
# Base: the published Z9X 1.0.9 image; every kept file is the base's byte for byte with its owner, mode, label and
# capability. What changes and why: devices/g0111/README.md; verify_tree_x50.py proves exactly that and nothing else.
# Flags: test (tN) or pub (a release version), stage (--stage-only), image (--image-only).
# the update client of a model with updates (build.conf derive=ota:pub): the neutral gate, its X50 data, the model's
# OTA certificates (tools/devices/ota/make_otacerts.py), the base's default permission file of org.lumen.updater
# the shared boot animation (overlay/v1/bootanimation.zip, git-ignored: tools/brand/gen_bootanim.py --add-audio over
# the 1.0.9 zip on the build host) must carry the power-on sound part0/audio.wav, every entry Stored
# the HAL app's calls against the allow lists of verify_tree_x50.py, with the model's own platform certificate (PCERT)
# the base, the stock model props of the dump, the X50 kernel (the base's ART boot image needs userfaultfd)
# the tree: root copy, removals, the platform set on the model's keys, otacerts without a certificate (a model with
# updates: its OTA certificates, below), props
# the one first-start setting of every image (devices/_image/first_start_prop.txt: English, the time zone from the
# network) at the end of the product build.prop, and the base's stock-data block without the Z9X's own language and zone
# network adb (test images only), the one blobs reader of every model over the base's Z9X copy, with the X50 family's
# settings (blobs.conf: 16 MiB partition, the eye-protection drawer, in a trial run the stock slot) and placeholders
# Lumen's power-on sound: init copies the projector app's gate to persist.sys.bootanim.play_sound (lumen-audio BootSound)
# the shared boot animation with that sound over the base's 1.0.9 member (no sound: the cold boot stayed silent), as
# the Z9X and HB recipes ship it; the frames are the base's (verify_tree_x50.py), the bootanimation-dark.zip link stays
# the eye-follow fail-safe (persistent system app), the power keys and their framework RRO
# the system package installer in the Lumen look (apps/LumenPackageInstallerOverlay, static RRO, no dex): the GSI's TV
# theme puts the uninstall guided step into a floating dialog (one letter per line), this overlay fixes it for every model
# Lumen Home and the HDMI input of this tree over the base's (their oat files were compiled for the base APKs)
# Lumen Setup of this tree (apps/LumenSetup through its shared recipe apps/LumenSetup/app.layers, signed with the
# model's platform key on the Mac) over the base's re-signed 1.0.9 copy, as the Z9X recipe; its base oat files go
# the on-screen keyboard of every model: Lumen Keyboard (apps/LumenKeyboard, the LeanbackIME package with keyboard
# languages and a language key) in LeanbackIME's place; the base's odex of the old APK goes
# Wi-Fi Direct (screen mirroring) on the MediaTek pre-freeze supplicant: the base's Wi-Fi APEX with service-wifi.jar
# rebuilt from lineage/patches/wifi/0001, re-signed with the base's Lumen APEX keys,
# owner, mode and label as the base's; the base's dexpreopt files of the old jar go (ART would refuse them)
# the video player of every model: Lumen Play (com.xgimiru.player) as its published APK with its own key, so its own
# updates install over it, a plain system app with its libraries unpacked and its licence notice (DLNA renderer and
# browser send from the first boot: tools/build/prebuilt.py, devices/_image/prebuilt.tsv, build.conf prebuilt=)
# screen casting on every model (2026-11-21, owner: one shared feature set): the AirPlay receiver with the casting
# screen of this tree (apps/LumenAirPlay, signed with the model's platform key, its native library from the released
# pin) over the base's 1.0.9 copy (its oat goes), the Miracast sink (priv-app with its privileged and default
# permissions), the Wi-Fi Direct device type TV (static RRO) and a sysconfig that starts the sink from the first boot
# (the base's 1.0.9 z9x.xml predates it and stays). The stock vendor of every model of the
# family runs wpa_supplicant with p2p0 and declares android.hardware.wifi.direct (devices/<c>/cast.conf).
# install from a DSU try: the app, its init rc and its root script
# Files (apps/LumenFiles, org.lumen.files): the file manager of every model in place of the stock one; a priv-app, so the
# package installer takes its APKs as a trusted source (one confirm window), no privileged permission, no permissions file
# the signal panel's HDMI receiver bridge (apps/core/lumen-signal/image, signal.tsv hdmi_format): a root oneshot that
# reads the MStar receiver's report, the same script as the Z9X and the Z9X HB
# the problem report log helper of every image (apps/core/lumen-report/image, staged for every device by
# tools/build/build.py COMMON_FILES): a root oneshot that hands the report app the scrubbed system log without a dialog
# the update client of a model with updates (flag ota: a public image whose build.conf says derive=ota:pub; owner
# 2026-11-14, rules.md 2.34): the base's Z9X gate out (remove_ota.txt), the neutral gate in (lumen_ota.rc, the
# update_verifier.rc that runs it, lumen_ota.sh, ota_gate.conf), otacerts.zip with the model's OTA certificates, the
# shared updater (signed with the model's platform key on the Mac) and the base's default permission file of
# org.lumen.updater back at its path (remove.txt drops it with the Z9X updater)
